summary.headline: Synergy Green Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹75.71 crore and 7% PBDIT margin were weak; management reiterates ₹500 crore FY27 revenue and 300 bps margin uplift.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 total income was ₹75.71 crore with absolute PBDIT of ₹5.3 crore at a 7% margin, as dispatches slipped on customer lifting, prototype approval delays and shipping constraints. Production rose about 10% YoY and the new 45,000 tpa capacity reached 66% utilisation in Q1, with July utilisation at 85% (about 3,200 tons). Raw material, consumable and energy inflation (linked to the West Asia conflict and an MSEDCL solar banking change) cut margins, which management expects to partly recover from Q2 via one-quarter-lagged indexation. Management maintained FY27 guidance of ~₹500 crore revenue (33% growth) and ~300 bps PBDIT margin expansion.

segments.name: Wind foundry (SG iron, grey iron, steel castings, 3-30 MT)
segments.commentary: Capacity expanded from 30,000 to 45,000 tpa; FY26 utilisation was 93% on old capacity. Q1 utilisation 66% on new capacity, July at 85%, with 80-90% targeted within 2-3 months.

segments.name: Machining (in-house)
segments.commentary: Machining capacity 20,000 tpa; product development 50% complete and utilisation reached 50% in July. Target 40-50% in-house machining, reducing outsourcing costs.

segments.name: Non-wind (power, mining, L&T, BHEL, Terex)
segments.commentary: BHEL PO received in Q1 (8-9 months development); L&T development underway. Terex order book strong on yen appreciation (~20% vs INR). Non-wind and gearboxes ~30% of revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance ~₹500 crore (33% growth), reiterated despite weak Q1.
FY27 full-year PBDIT margin to improve ~300 bps YoY, driven by volumes, export concentration in H2 and machining contribution.
Q2 expected to see indexation recoveries on raw material (~200 bps) and partial consumables recovery; new customer revenues from Q2.
Utilisation target of 80% on full 45,000 tpa capacity for FY27; 80-90% within 2-3 months from July.
Executable order book positioned at ₹500 crore for FY27; ₹600 crore achievable next year with higher capacity.
Land for 100,000 tpa project targeted by December or March; next project start by Q3 of next year; fundraising ideally Q1/Q2 2028.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity 45,000 tpa (expanded from 30,000 tpa); in-house machining 20,000 tpa; 10 MW captive solar.
Plan for 100,000 tpa capacity; land acquisition targeted by December or March; greenfield capex takes 15-18 months to commission.
Additional 5 MW wind PPA via open access to offset power cost inflation; solar + PPA to cover 50-60% of power needs.
Vestas 4 MW platform: tooling started mid-May; samples expected Q4 FY27, full production Q1 FY28. Nordex NX N 5 MW prototypes cleared in Q1.
Inventory held at 8-10 weeks; target to keep shop order book below 8 weeks.
demand_pricing: Q1 dispatches lower due to delayed customer material lifting and prototype approvals with a key customer; export rollouts hit by ship availability amid West Asia conflict. Unsold production went into inventory.
Furan Resin (third-largest cost item) rose ~60%; PNG/LNG prices up 60-70%; pig iron and CRC inflation from shortages and imported scrap logistics.
Realisations expected to rise from ₹138-140/kg to ₹145+ levels in coming quarters; management said no change in realisation in Q1.
Vestas ~40-45% of business historically, expected to fall toward ~30% as new OEMs (Nordex, Adani) are added; Nordex growing; Adani 3.3 MW in serial production.
Indian suppliers estimated 5-10% cheaper than China on landed cost for wind products after yen appreciation; US market favours non-Chinese suppliers.
Management views wind demand stronger than solar; night-time wind tariffs 25% higher than solar daytime, per management.

qa_highlights.question: Could the ₹500 crore FY27 target slip into next year given slow offtake?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 production was strong but did not convert to sales; Q2 execution is at a much higher flow rate, and product approval has come from 50% of customers.

qa_highlights.question: Did realisations spike given 66% utilisation implies ~7,400 MT?
qa_highlights.answer: No; management said produced material was not all sold, creating inventory, and realisation is unchanged, with revenue recognition pending.

qa_highlights.question: Is other income of ₹4.4 crore from power sales?
qa_highlights.answer: No; likely FX-related or export incentives. Management has not sold power; solar lapsed units were lost under the MSEDCL policy change.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the ₹600-700 crore order book?
qa_highlights.answer: Renamed the executable order book; ₹500 crore set for FY27 given hurdles, with ₹600 crore possible next year on higher capacity.

qa_highlights.question: When will the next capex and fundraising happen?
qa_highlights.answer: Two or three good quarters needed first; land by December or March; project start by Q3 next year; fundraising ideally Q1/Q2 2028.

qa_highlights.question: Will Vestas concentration stay the same at ~₹600 crore revenue in two years?
qa_highlights.answer: Vestas wants more allocation but capacity is going to new OEMs (Nordex, Adani) each allocating ₹100-150 crore; wind is ~₹400 crore of revenue, non-wind and gearboxes ~30%.

qa_highlights.question: Is offshore wind or Adani 5 MW participation viable?
qa_highlights.answer: Adani 5 MW parts often exceed 30 MT, so imported from China; Adani 5.2 MW bearing (6-7 ton casting) supplied. Offshore volumes not expected for 5-10 years; company focuses on 3-4 MW onshore.
